related.title: SMAP L 波段亮溫與土壤反演
related.titleEn: SMAP L-band brightness temperature and soil retrieval
related.transfer: 沿觀測目標、載荷、校準鏈與使用者資料對照邊界。
related.transferEn: Compare boundaries across target, payload, calibration chain, and user product.
related.why: 兩課都要求可複查的校準、量測與資料品質表；請先找到證據格式的共通欄位。
related.whyEn: Both courses require a reviewable calibration, measurement, and product-quality table. First find the evidence fields they share.
related.difference: 完成「SMAP L 波段亮溫與土壤反演」工作台並留下可重做的工程紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Complete the smap l-band brightness temperature and soil retrieval bench and produce a reproducible engineering record.
practice: 各選一個名義結果，保留輸入與來源。
對照介面、失效條件與資料解析度。
把一項驗證改編到另一案例，記下不可沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Select one nominal result in each case, retaining inputs and sources.
Compare interfaces, failure conditions, and data resolution.
Transfer a verification to the other case and document assumptions that do not carry across.

courses.overview: 比較太空載荷、遙測與資料產品中兩種案例的介面與驗證方法，並轉移一個工程判斷。
courses.overviewEn: Compare interfaces and verification approaches in two space payloads, remote sensing, and data products cases, then transfer one engineering judgment.
